title: Treating energy crisis with fossil fuels is like giving a diabetic sugar: EU Commissioner Jorgensen
summary: EU leaders have cautiously welcomed Donald Trump's signing of an interim agreement with Iran, after nearly four months of war in the Middle East. But it is only a Memorandum of Understanding, and Europeans know the US president too well to celebrate prematurely. The conflict has led to the most severe disruption in energy supplies in decades, and the EU has…
